# Command reference

polarln has 49 commands: 48 Polar tools and 1 polarln command. Each page shows the usage, the flags, the backends, the SDK method, and an example of one command.

The pages come from the bundled Polar tool schemas. With the bridge, the command list comes from the Polar app. Run `polarln --help` to see the commands of your Polar app.

The Docker column shows if the Docker backend supports the command. On Docker, the other commands give `501 PolarToolNotSupported`.

For the flags of all commands, see [Global flags](../cli.md#global-flags).

## Networks

| Command                                                 | Description                                                                                    | Docker   |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| [`list-networks`](list-networks.md)                     | Lists all Lightning Networks in Polar with their configurations and status.                    | yes      |
| [`create-network`](create-network.md)                   | Creates a new Lightning Network in Polar with the specified node implementations and versions. | yes      |
| [`import-network-from-zip`](import-network-from-zip.md) | Imports a Lightning Network from a .polar.zip file that was previously exported from Polar.    | no (501) |
| [`export-network-to-zip`](export-network-to-zip.md)     | Exports a Lightning Network to a .polar.zip file.                                              | no (501) |
| [`start-network`](start-network.md)                     | Starts a Lightning Network in Polar.                                                           | yes      |
| [`stop-network`](stop-network.md)                       | Stops a Lightning Network in Polar.                                                            | yes      |
| [`delete-network`](delete-network.md)                   | Permanently deletes a Lightning Network in Polar.                                              | yes      |
| [`rename-network`](rename-network.md)                   | Renames a Lightning Network in Polar and optionally updates its description.                   | yes      |

## Nodes

| [`set-lightning-backend`](set-lightning-backend.md)       | Changes the Bitcoin backend node for a Lightning Network node.                                                               | yes      |

| [`add-node`](add-node.md)                                 | Adds a Bitcoin Core or Lightning Network node to an existing Polar network.                                                  | yes      |
| [`start-node`](start-node.md)                             | Starts a specific node in a Polar network.                                                                                   | yes      |
| [`restart-node`](restart-node.md)                         | Restarts a specific node in a Polar network.                                                                                 | yes      |
| [`stop-node`](stop-node.md)                               | Stops a specific node in a Polar network.                                                                                    | yes      |
| [`remove-node`](remove-node.md)                           | Removes a node from an existing Polar network.                                                                               | yes      |
